context: A uni student interviews a retired engineer about high-rise design
purpose: Teach: 落下/最高裁判所/拒絶/探求/力学/神学/高層/個体

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 高層建築の設計、長年携わってこられたんですよね。
lines.en: You've spent a long time designing high-rise buildings, haven't you.
lines.style: Respectful lean-in, genuinely curious. Soft opening. Slight hesitation before asking, like gathering courage to ask someone you admire. Even pace, warm delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん。落下試験のデータ、個体差を考慮した解析が要だった。
lines.en: Yes. The key was analyzing the falling-test data while accounting for individual variance.
lines.style: Clear, measured, the voice of someone who has turned decades of work into clarity. Slight emphasis on 「要だった」—not proud, just factual. Pauses between clauses as if retrieving memory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 力学的な探求、終わりはあるんですか。
lines.en: Is there ever an end to mechanical inquiry?
lines.style: Genuine, searching question. Soft attack. Vulnerability showing through—not performing intellect but asking what he actually wonders. Slight lift at the end, inviting honesty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: いや。最高裁判所の判例が出ても、現場は続く。
lines.en: No. Even after Supreme Court rulings come down, the work in the field goes on.
lines.style: Unhurried, philosophical. A small pause after the negative—letting it sit. Then the explanation comes gently, like he's seen this cycle many times. Slight weariness underneath, not bitterness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 規制側の拒絶反応、当時もあったんですか。
lines.en: Were there pushback from regulators even back then?
lines.style: Genuine interest, no edge. Inviting him to continue. Lighter tone than the mechanical questions—almost conversational. As if checking a detail in a longer story.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ええ。神学的な議論を持ち出す人すらいた。
lines.en: Yes. Some people even brought up theological arguments.
lines.style: Dry, almost gentle amusement beneath the surface. A small shake of the head audible in the voice. Finality and acceptance mixed together. Voice settling, like the conversation has found its place.
